ideal: No malicious package installed; no vulnerability outlives a week; no secret in the repo; workflows least-privilege on pinned actions; Claude reads no credential.

parts.ideal: SECURITY.md names a private reporting channel that works for this repo's visibility
parts.setup: Add SECURITY.md; turn on private vulnerability reporting, which GitHub offers on public repos

parts.ideal: Vulnerability and malware alerts on; no malware alert open; no vulnerability alert older than a week
parts.setup: Enable both in the organization's security configuration; malware alerts are off until asked for

parts.ideal: Security fixes arrive grouped; a new release waits 14 days; packages come from one trusted registry
parts.setup: In dependabot.yml: a cooldown, and a group that applies to security updates

parts.ideal: Bought: scanning and push protection on. Free: a secret scan that must pass to merge
parts.setup: Enable Secret Protection, or require a pinned scanner's check in a ruleset

parts.ideal: Code scanning on where the repo is public or Code Security is bought; Code Quality where its license is bought; never billed unasked
parts.setup: Enable CodeQL default setup and Code Quality in the repo's security settings

parts.ideal: A read-only token by default; only listed actions run, each at a full commit SHA or in a lockfile
parts.setup: Actions settings: selected actions, required SHA pins, read-only workflow permissions

parts.ideal: Claude Code cannot read a credential file in the repo or the home folder
parts.setup: Deny Read rules for .env, key and secrets paths in .claude/settings.json

parts.ideal: Each covered element has its threat, control and gap, re-read as part of routine development
parts.setup: THREAT-MODEL.md beside the code; name the paths it covers and the days it may trail them
